_comment: Skill Repo Spec v1 s9 -- every path in this repo belongs to exactly one class.
TOOL    = code, docs, and metrics ABOUT THE TOOL. Public.
FIXTURE = LIFELIKE test data, produced by a generator so a pasted real record fails at commit.
DATA    = anything a REAL RUN produced. Never in this public repo.
data_sealed = a path that HELD real data, was purged, and must stay dead.
Enforced by tools/data_boundary.py from the fleet-guards checkout (git config fleet.guards) through .githooks.
_audited: 2026-09-27: reviewed write sites in core, cli, session_ops and transactions. All transcripts and session metadata are supplied by callers through an explicit absolute root. Fork creates a new file; rename appends a native custom-title record and updates the native index; move renames a transcript and its complete sidecar tree and updates source/destination indexes. Recovery journals and the root mutation lock live under the caller root in .convo-chain-ops. Mutation roots within git worktrees are refused before a lock, journal or index is written. CLI export remains exclusive-create and refuses worktree destinations. There is no repository-relative DATA fallback. No transcript fixture or real-run output is committed. Empty DATA and FIXTURE path lists describe this package checkout, not the caller-owned storage. data_boundary's run-shape check covers the transcript names this tool writes (listed in _run_shape_probes); an exported Markdown file has no distinguishing shape, so it stays pending, and the export is refused inside any git work tree. .gitignore also excludes *.jsonl, *.jsonl.gz, .fork-*.tmp and exports/.
